sources.title: Shift Parallelism: Low-Latency, High-Throughput LLM Inference for Dynamic Workloads
sources.snippet: Efficient parallelism is necessary for achieving low-latency, high-throughput inference with large language models (LLMs). Tensor parallelism (TP) is the state-of-the-art method for reducing LLM response latency, however GPU communications reduces combined token throughput. On the other hand, data parallelism (DP) obtains a higher throughput yet is slow in response latency.
